plugins.name: godw-design
plugins.description: godw design-pipeline plugin: three-stage pipeline — stage 1 raw requirement (human-in-loop freeze) -> stage 2 4A architecture + identity cards (1a split produces requirement legs + frozen 身份卡.md persona/exam/matrix + reference-materials INDEX ledger; 1b four standalone docs + detail.json single field-level source + trace table; 1c doc gate) -> stage 3 interactive prototype (delegated to godw-html lo-fi line; 2b prototype gate; 2c wrap-up & auto-archive). godw-design-orchestrator (renamed from start) auto-detects current stage/step from directory state with a state.md progress panel reconciled at startup (directory wins), advances to stage end; the freeze gate stays human-in-loop. godw-design-gate dispatches dynamic user jurors from the frozen identity card (goal sentences only, answer-sheet 能做/卡住/靠猜 instead of scores; fixed jurors keep scores) with convergence registry + anchor card + explore-to-converge rhythm + blocker admission + regression-juror-only verdicts. godw-design-check mechanical gate: trace chain, anti-fabrication, cross-refs, terminology, guess-ledger reconciliation, diagram name alignment. Requirement backflow v2 absorbs gated increments as GR ids and internalizes reference materials via the RF ledger; the requirement doc stays fully frozen. + 3 fixed juror subagents (read-only, scores kept) + ID traceability FR/NFR/GR through the chain. Sibling plugins: godw-goal, godw-html, godw-toolkit. v0.3.0: three-stage orchestrator rename (start -> orchestrator) + state.md reconciliation; identity-card + answer-sheet exams replace dynamic-juror scoring; reference-materials internalization (INDEX ledger + archive, requirement doc back to fully frozen); business-architecture 6-section rework (goals & boundaries / use-case overview / fixed sequence diagrams) + info-architecture KPI section; check adds diagram-name & guess-ledger checks. v0.4.0 (evidence-based prototype acceptance, from real-world company feedback): new gate/scripts/walk.mjs Playwright walker (doctor preflight stops on missing deps instead of downgrading; headless scenario execution; per-step + auto full-page screenshots; trace.json with runId; WALK_CONCURRENCY optional self-limit, unlimited by default); prototype dynamic jurors must really run the walker and answer with evidence (the read-code-inference escape hatch is deleted), answer sheets without runId+evidence are voided and re-dispatched without consuming rounds; the main agent only dispatches/verifies evidence/verdicts and never ghostwrites (juror independence); check.mjs emits ranAt/newestSourceMtime run receipts and revisions must paste raw JSON from a real bash run; orchestrator runs doctor before 2b. v0.5.0 (four-stage pipeline + PRD + LikeC4, user-driven iteration): pipeline extended to 原始需求 → 4A架构 → PRD → 原型系统 with step ids 阶段<数字>-<字母> and parameterized launch (start|document|prd|prototype, bare = auto-detect); new 6th self-built skill godw-design-prd-compose (stage 3-a: PRD/ folder per functional module — overview PRD-<design>.md + per-module files, EARS acceptance criteria (WHEN/IF/WHILE…SHALL, machine-lintable), ≤30 ACs per module, Assumptions + [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] dual channel, banned-phrase self-check, fields referenced from detail.json only); gate adds prd mode adversarial review (identity-card jurors mind-walk the PRD + saboteur walks failure paths + simplicity officer; PASS same answer-sheet bar, snapshot gate-prd-pass) and prototype gate now checks against the PRD (in PRD but missing in prototype = blocker); check --phase gains prd (trace table PRD column, EARS lint, AC uniqueness/≤30, banned phrases, two-way page coverage, overview links, NEEDS CLARIFICATION count) plus likec4 validate integration; **LikeC4 model source**: 4A架构/model.c4 as the single source for architecture (roles/systems/modules/dependencies), context & container diagrams generated via likec4 gen mermaid (never hand-written), humans view via export png/serve; prototype leg and brief retired (superseded by PRD + detail); selection-gate pitfalls baked in (CJK text needs quotes, include * only in scoped views, gen does not gate validity — always validate first).

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: Godw Design：设计流水线域（需求→四架构文档→可交互原型）

description_i18n.zh-CN: godw设计流水线域插件。三阶段：阶段一 原始需求（人在环冻结）→ 阶段二 4A架构+身份卡（1a 备料产出两腿+身份卡.md〔身份卡组+考题六类+身份×题矩阵，冻结〕+参考资料 INDEX 建账；1b 四文档+detail.json 唯一字段源+需求追踪；1c 门1）→ 阶段三 原型系统（委托 godw-html lo-fi 线；2b 门2；2c 收口归档）。godw-design-orchestrator（原 start 更名）按目录实况自动识别所处阶段与步骤，state.md 进度面板启动对账（以目录为准），推进到本阶段末尾停；冻结门人在环不自动跨。godw-design-gate 用冻结身份卡派动态用户评委（只发目标句不发流程；答卷表 能做/卡住/靠猜 替代打分，固定评委打分保留），配收敛登记表+锚定卡+两期节奏+blocker 准入+回归评委判定。godw-design-check 机械门：追踪链/防发明/互引/术语/靠猜对账/配图名单对齐。回流协议 v2 吸收 GR 增量并经 RF 登记账内化参考资料；原始需求回归完全冻结。+ agents/ 三固定评委（只读）+ FR/NFR/GR 全链贯穿。按名调用 godw-goal/godw-html/godw-toolkit。 v0.3.0：三阶段编排器更名+state.md 对账；身份卡+答卷表替换动态评委打分；参考资料内化（INDEX+archive）；业务架构六节重排+信息架构指标口径节；check 增配图与靠猜校验。 v0.4.0（证据化验收，公司实测反馈）：新增 gate/scripts/walk.mjs Playwright 走查器（doctor 预检缺依赖停线不降级；无头执行；每步截图+自动全页截图；trace.json 含 runId；WALK_CONCURRENCY 可选自限默认不限）；prototype 动态评委必须真跑走查器出证据后答卷（删读码推演逃生口），无 runId+证据的答卷作废重派不算轮次；主 agent 只派发/核对/判定不代笔（评委独立性）；check.mjs 输出 ranAt/newestSourceMtime 真跑凭证，修订须 bash 真跑并原样贴 JSON；orchestrator 2b 前置 doctor 预检。 v0.5.0（四阶段+PRD+LikeC4，用户驱动迭代）：流水线扩为四阶段——原始需求 → 4A架构 → PRD → 原型系统，步骤号改 阶段<数字>-<字母>，调用参数化 start|document|prd|prototype 四档（无参自动识别续跑）；新增第 6 自研技能 godw-design-prd-compose（阶段3-a：PRD/ 按功能模块分文件——总览 PRD-<设计名>.md + 每模块 PRD-<模块名>.md，EARS 验收标准 WHEN/IF/WHILE…SHALL 机器可 lint、单模块 AC ≤30、Assumptions 与 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] 双通道禁编造、禁词自查、字段只引 detail.json）；gate 新增 prd 模式对抗审查（身份卡评委思维走查+找茬者走歪题+简洁官，PASS 同答卷口径、快照 gate-prd-pass），prototype 门对照 PRD（写了没做=blocker）；check --phase 扩 prd（追踪表 PRD 列、EARS lint、AC 唯一 ≤30、禁词、页面双向覆盖、总览链接、NC 计数）+ likec4 validate 集成；LikeC4 模型源：4A架构/model.c4 架构单一事实源，上下文/容器图由 likec4 gen mermaid 生成不手写，人看 export png/serve；原型腿与 brief 退役；选型验证踩坑已固化（CJK 加引号/include * 仅限作用域视图/gen 不 gate 有效性）。
